deploymentTopology.summary: containers on a managed PaaS, rolling deployment behind its load balancer

authz.summary: session cookie; every repository call takes the member's household id

security.summary: TLS in transit, database encryption at rest, no PII beyond display names

audit.summary: membership changes written to the audit sink with actor and time

rollback.summary: feature flag shared_lists, and the previous image redeployed

disasterRecovery.summary: point-in-time recovery with a 5 minute RPO and a 1 hour RTO

dataModel.summary: households, members, items; household_id on every row

eventContract.reason: the service publishes no domain events; it only emits telemetry

nfrLandingPoints.mechanism: one indexed query per list read, household_id leading the index
household id is a required argument of every query, taken from the session
